PLAN "Integrated 12-Week Low-Impact Strength, Nutrition, Cardio, and Recovery Plan for Knee-Friendly Ski Return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Full 12-week integrated program to regain strength, build cardio fitness, and prepare for skiing with knee-safe loads"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundational strength and safe warmup":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Core stability and upper lift form":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower body and core with controlled ROM":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          sumo_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
    2x Phase 1 wrap-up: Phase 1 ends with readiness check and plan for Phase 2 progression.
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progressive loading with knee-friendly stance":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_c_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Posterior chain and upper push/pull":
        warmup:
          walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift_variant 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          ab_wheel 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Volume maintenance with safe ROM":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pectoral_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength ceilings with controlled knee load":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat alternative 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lunge 3x6..8 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          leg_curl 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Grip and core + upper strength":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up_assisted 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          planks 3x45 seconds rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Low-impact ski-sim prep and mobility":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10 per leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13 (Phase 4 start):
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak strength with safe mechanics":
        warmup:
          cycling 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift_variant 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Accessory stability and skiing transfer":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mrotation 60 seconds
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 55m "Taper and ski mechanics":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 60 seconds

CARDIO MODALITIES (warmups/cooldowns/cardio)
  - walking
  - cycling
  - rowing
  - incline walking (as cardio variant)
  - tempo bursts and intervals defined in plan
  - no jumping; low-impact substitutions as needed

NUTRITION SUPPORT
- Calorie target: maintenance with strategic peak-load adjustments during Peak Weeks.
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day, distributed across 3–5 meals; up to 1.8–2.2 g/kg on peak-load days.
- Carbs: tuned to training demand; modest bump around heavier lifting blocks.
- Fats: focus on essential fats; fish, olive oil, nuts, seeds.
- Hydration: 3–3.5 liters daily; electrolytes as needed for longer cardio blocks.
- Timing: protein and carbs around workouts; post-workout protein within 1–2 hours.
- Supplements: whey protein to hit targets; creatine monohydrate 3–5 g/day if clinician approves; vitamin D/multivitamin as indicated.

RECOVERY & MOBILITY PLAN (within overall schedule)
- Plan 6-week Mobility Phase integrated alongside workouts; 3 sessions/week, 15–30 minutes, focusing on knee-friendly ROM, thoracic mobility, hip hinge, and scapular mechanics.
- Recovery nutrition aligns with protein targets and sleep.

MONITORING & SAFETY
- Weekly weight checks; adjust calories ±100–200 kcal if drift occurs.
- Track knee symptoms; avoid deep knee flexion under load; substitute safe ROM movements as needed.
- Ski transfer readiness assessed via mobility tests and controlled strength movements; escalate only with clinician clearance.

SUPPORTING NOTES
- Peak Week Structure: Weeks 11–12 emphasize neural readiness, controlled loading, and maintenance calories with strategic protein and carbohydrate timing to maximize strength expression without knee overload.
- Printable plan available on request, with daily macros and a one-page checklist.

If you want, I can generate exact daily macro targets, a shopping list, or a printable spreadsheet version.
